threshold_rule: min_ratio = floor(1 + (measured_ratio - 1) * 0.5, 0.1) — fails when the SIMD advantage halves vs the pin (dispatch degraded to scalar -> ratio ~1.0), with enough slack for machine noise

limiter.dot/256: compute-bound: fp mul+add throughput on ~1 KiB resident streams; dispatch cost amortized (no scalar-routing floor on this kernel)
limiter.dot/1024: compute-bound: fp mul+add throughput on ~4 KiB resident streams; dispatch cost amortized (no scalar-routing floor on this kernel)
limiter.dot/4096: compute-bound: fp mul+add throughput on ~16 KiB resident streams; dispatch cost amortized (no scalar-routing floor on this kernel)
limiter.fir/256: compute-bound: len*64-tap MAC loop on ~1 KiB src (taps L1-resident); zero-history head is a fixed cost
limiter.fir/1024: compute-bound: len*64-tap MAC loop on ~4 KiB src (taps L1-resident); zero-history head is a fixed cost
limiter.fir/4096: compute-bound: len*64-tap MAC loop on ~16 KiB src (taps L1-resident); zero-history head is a fixed cost
